_meta.status: Indicative demo values compiled from public secondary sources (e.g. PayBima, bimacalculator); not verified against the IRDAI/insurer policy wording.

third_party_only.label: Third-party only
third_party_only.description: Covers liability to others. No own-damage cover for your vehicle.

standard_comprehensive.label: Standard comprehensive
standard_comprehensive.description: Own-damage cover with the standard depreciation schedule and compulsory deductible.

comprehensive_zero_dep.label: Comprehensive + zero depreciation
comprehensive_zero_dep.description: Own-damage cover where parts depreciation is waived. Compulsory deductible still applies.
